title: The product exponent 603/1000 sits under the Fourier allowance
body:
## Summary
- At `epsilon = 997/1000`, the online product exponent is `8/5 - epsilon = 603/1000`.
- That is strictly less than the inherited Fourier exponent `1 - 576/332929 = 332353/332929`.
- For every `m >= 1`, the scaled coefficient error is strictly below `1/8`. Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no convolution replay.
